observed.claim: each tool takes one JSON object and returns one, or an error contract
list_devices, open_session, identify and close_session find the instrument and read its identity; none writes a setting
status returns the state, whether the device is initialised and homed, a fault if there is one, the temperature, the gap, the time and the run id, and changes nothing
ranges returns the modes and, per quantity, the lowest and highest value and the unit, as the device reports them about itself, and changes nothing
initialise, home, set_shear_rate, start, stop and self_calibrate change the device, and every one of them is behind the bundle's gate
the start-up order is the air supply and the transport lock by a person, then initialise, then home, and the device is ready when status says idle, initialised and homed with no fault
the motor adjustment is calibrated by the device's own routine and torque against a standard a person loads

gaps.what: how the normal force is calibrated
gaps.requires: the section of a manual on the normal force transducer

gaps.what: a real instrument behaves as the mock adapters do
gaps.requires: analysis_permission confirmed by a person (granted_by, scope, basis, date)
